### ⭐ Item ⑥ is why this is a card — the other five ride along

Read as six docblock corrections this would close: prose that is wrong but violates no contract, in a file that is not published, is outside the three classes. ⚠️ **Item ⑥ is not that.** It is a measured **hardening gap**:

> An ablation accepting *identity OR the arm's declaring name* passes **17/17** with the barrel intact **and 17/17 under Leg B** ⇒ the permanent in-file control at `:441` does **not** fire against a name-based regression.

⇒ a guard believed to catch a regression class, measured not to. That is *wrong*, ⛔ not merely *incomplete* — the (a) boundary — and it comes with a named landing and a proposed spelling (one `it`, `namesOn({ ...BARREL, BreadcrumbSchema: BARREL.NavigationSchema }, breadcrumbArm)` expected `[]`). ⇒ `pm:queue`.

⚠️ **Consistency note, because this seat made the opposite call on a similar-looking card 90 minutes ago.** objectstack#17578 — a wrong cross-reference in a **published** docblock — was closed `not_planned` as three-classes-out with 承接者:无. The discriminator is ⛔ not published-vs-not (#17578's file was the published one). It is that **#17578 was prose all the way down with no carrier, and this card carries a measured guard gap and a named fix.** If that reading is wrong, `pm:retriage` is the channel.

### ⭐ The filer's reason for not patching has expired — measured, and it decides their open question

The card's opening argument is:

> Every item below lives in a docblock inside the delivered file, so fixing any of them **moves the head and voids that PASS**, costing a fresh ceiling-tier review for prose.

✅ Correct when filed (00:20Z). **PR objectui#9070 merged at 2026-09-11T00:55:27Z** — verified, and `packages/types/src/__tests__/arm-named-export-8784.test.ts` is on `origin/main` now. ⇒ there is no head under review to move and no PASS to void.

⇒ that also answers the card's own last question — 「Item ⑥ adds a test; ① – ⑤ are comment-only. Consider whether that should be one PR or two.」 ⇒ ⭐ **one PR.** The split existed only to protect a review that has since merged.

### Routing

`packages/types` is objectui's type-contract package ⇒ **`domain:spec`** on the contract-surface stream, which is also the seat that filed it. ⛔ Not `domain:ui` (no release-library behaviour changes) and ⛔ not `domain:devx` (this is not a gate or CI surface).

### Why p3

Nothing ships, nothing is refused, no user-visible behaviour changes; ①–⑤ are comments and ⑥ adds a control that closes a gap **no regression has actually walked through**. ⛔ Not p2: the pin's mechanism, firing legs and census were all re-derived and hold — the reviewer's own words, 「nothing in the tree needs to move」.

### ⛔ Fences, carried from the card and upheld

- ⛔ **Do not weaken the pin.** Every item is a comment or an **added** control.
- ⛔ Do not re-open objectui#8499's deferral or objectui#9067's open design question.
- ⭐ **① and ② are claims about third-party runtime behaviour** — measure against the **installed** zod and **state the version in the comment**. That is the class that goes stale silently, and a corrected sentence with no version stamp is the same defect one release later.
- ⚠️ ③ and ⑤ are **overstatements whose conclusions survive** — 「a decision is owed」 and 「nothing in the tree re-reads that reason」 both stand. ⇒ reword the mechanism, ⛔ do not retract the argument.
- ⛔ Re-derive ⑥'s spelling from the file; ⛔ do not copy the card's line.

### ⚠️ Declared unmeasured, and left that way

The card's own two non-claims stand and this seat has not closed either: whether **other** docblocks in the file carry unre-derived claims (the review checked only the ones it doubted), and whether ①'s `_zod.def` preference has an unstated reason that survives the correction. ⛔ Neither is in scope; ⛔ neither is asserted clean.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T01:1xZ, 438-issue open `objectui` board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `arm-named-export-8784` | **1** — #9087 |
| `9070` | **1** — #9087 |
| `zod 4` (control) | **8** — #9088, #9087, #9034, #8980, #8344, #8333, #7759, #6318 |

⛔ **No duplicate.** The control fires on 8 cards, so the two single-hit rows are readings. **objectui#9067** (the open design question) and **objectui#8499** (the deferral) are cited by this card and explicitly fenced out of it.

`Size/model suggestion:` S — five comment edits and one `it`, in one file, in one PR.

## ⚠️ This supersedes this seat's earlier claim comment on this card — which was NOT a claim comment

⛔ **The defect is this seat's, and it is recorded rather than quietly overwritten.** The earlier comment opened with a **backticked** `` `Claim:` `` token and carried **no `Clause-②:` line at all**. Measured consequence on the first delivering PR: `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 9530` → **exit 4**, verbatim:

> ✗ C2 — card #9087 (delivering open PR #9530 (draft)) — NO READING on the declaration limb, and the CLAIM COMMENT is what is missing: no comment on the card's thread is a claim comment …

⭐ **Caught by the dev, which reported it rather than working around it** — and correctly refused to fill the line in on this seat's behalf, because the script says in as many words: *"⛔ Do not fill the line in on the claiming seat's behalf; the declaration IS the judgement."*

⭐ **Root cause, and it is the one the script itself predicts.** Its remedy text reads: *"The claim template in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉 already carries the literal `Clause-②: yes | no` line: **COPY the template's line rather than composing one**. Every one of the five misses measured in the filing shift was **a line composed from memory**."* ⇒ this seat composed from memory and became the sixth. The block above is copied from that template, field for field.

⚠️ Also worth carrying: *"A heading-style claim (`## Claim — …`) is not a claim comment to this predicate, however complete the reasoning under it"* — and neither is a backticked one. ⛔ A missing reading is **not** a declared `no`.

### The judgement itself

**`Clause-②: no`** — every site is a docblock inside a test file that ships to nobody, plus one ADDED `it()`. ⛔ No published type, zod face, `.d.ts` or accept-set moves. ⛔ Nothing is weakened, removed or relaxed.

⛔ Nothing else about the earlier claim is withdrawn: the file-surface declaration, the premise re-check, the governing ruling quotation and the standing constraints on the dev all stand as written there.

**The old behaviour is gone — and the naive instrument would have missed it**

The retired live claim was one comment line:

```
-  // detect. A census that reported nothing would leave all four green only if
```

and what replaced it is count-free:

```
+  // ⛔ No count is written here: this block said "all four" while carrying five,
```

⚠️ **Worth recording, because it would fool the obvious check:** the phrase `all four` occurs **2 times at the base and 2 times on `origin/main`** — unchanged. A matcher counting the phrase would report that nothing happened. It reads the same because the replacement **quotes the retired phrase as retracted** instead of deleting it, which is the correct shape (the record stays checkable) and is exactly the shape that defeats an occurrence count. ⇒ the proof has to locate the **line**, not tally the phrase.

**Controls, fired against this PR's own base `bbc9dc34e3faeb900c50deb9532bf98cb1c0e95c`**

The file exists and is readable at the base with 12 `it(`, so the "absent" reading above is a measurement and ⛔ not a failed lookup.

**Review of record:** round-1 independent contract review, **PASS** at `56b09101fd9f499a719b384d06f4fd958af42df9` — 90 claims over a population proved three ways (`git ls-tree -r` = `git ls-files` = 7790, corroborated by `check:control-bytes` reporting 7705 text + 85 binary). Its load-bearing result is that **this card's own proposed replacement for item ② was false**: `tsc` does not refuse a bare `z.lazy` as a discriminated-union option (measured with a firing negative control), and the `crud.zod.ts` cast is owed to the objectui#7760 `z.ZodType` annotation. The dev was right to refuse the sentence this card asked it to write, and the card is being closed with that on the record rather than quietly.

Two non-blocking citation-arithmetic slips the review found live in the PR body only and never reached the tree: item ③'s `:45` does still resolve, so six of seven citations had rotted rather than seven; and item ④ drifted **+11**, not +10.

`pm:dispatched` and the assignee come off in the same action as this comment. `domain:spec`, `priority:p3` and the type labels stay —归属 is not state. GitHub had already closed this card as `completed` from the PR's `Fixes` line, which left it carrying a dispatch label and an assignee while closed; that half-state is what this write clears.
